title: Understand Microsoft Copilot Chat vs Microsoft Copilot (licensed)
problem: Leadership is confused about what's free and what requires a license.
steps: Naming: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now called Microsoft Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now Microsoft Copilot Chat.
Microsoft Copilot Chat is included for users with an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription: web-grounded chat, file upload and agents, with enterprise data protection.
Pay-as-you-go billing can be turned on for metered agents in Copilot Chat, SharePoint agents and the Copilot Retrieval API.
Microsoft Copilot (add-on license) adds work grounding across Microsoft Graph and the full in-app experiences.
Map scenarios to the right tier before buying.
pitfalls: Pay-as-you-go needs a billing policy (Azure subscription + users) connected to the Copilot service — set a budget with email alerts. It's off by default.
done_when: Each planned scenario is mapped to Copilot Chat (included), pay-as-you-go agents or the Microsoft Copilot add-on license.
Leadership has signed off on that mapping before any licenses are bought.
